full_judgment: 12. The respondent has not violated any law and rules in holding the trial in question under Mobile Court Ain, 2009. The correspondent of Daily Star in making report in question did not try to find out the truth about the facts. On the basis of presumption and wrong information he sent the news and the Daily Star without further scrutiny had published the news in question. The contention of news in question was based on totally wrong information.
